name: Broadcasts
description: WhatsApp campaigns over the flow API, the way a mailing tool does them: a campaign list with a side panel, a composer that picks an approved template and fills its blanks against a live preview with contact-field personalisation, an audience builder with a live recipient count, send now / later / recurring in the bot's own timezone, and a read-only template catalog with a hand-off to WhatsApp Manager. Every campaign is a flow the dashboard shows too.

permissions.requiredFor: listing campaigns — every campaign is a flow, read through the bot's flow groups

creating, filling, scheduling, sending, taking off the schedule and deleting a campaign — every broadcast write is a flow-builder block mutation, and the server checks Flows: Edit on each, not Broadcasting
the template catalog, the bot's timezone and the connected WhatsApp number
the attribute catalog behind the audience builder and the personalisation picker, and the recipient count
